metadata.description: Agent skills from Precedent Labs: reusable workflows distilled from real sessions.

plugins.name: review-loop
plugins.description: Subagent review workflows: implement → review → fix loops until clean, triage of findings into fix/defer/reject decisions, and model-tiered fix fanout after a parallel review.

plugins.name: optimization
plugins.description: Metric-driven optimization loop: profile, one change at a time, measure, accept or reject, regression gate, record. The goal is given on the command line.
